title: NCAA: Sison-Walker avoids serious injury, Manalili sidelined by wrist issue
summary: Denzil Sison-Walker avoided a serious injury while Titing Manalili was sidelined by a wrist issue as Colegio de San Juan de Letran absorbed its first loss in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball.
